primary_rules.probe_to_gene_resolution: unique Entrez-to-HGNC first; approved/alias/previous symbol only when unique
primary_rules.multi_uniprot_gene: resolve only if exactly one candidate matches the HGNC approved primary symbol; otherwise exclude
primary_rules.isoform: canonical accession only; accession containing dash is excluded
primary_rules.unmapped_features: retain in audit table and exclude from primary protein model
